description: OpenAI-compatible serverless and dedicated inference for optimized open-weight models.
residency_notes: Inceptron offers optional EU-only processing, under which compute and logs remain in-region. The public catalogue does not identify a default execution region per serverless model.
regional_pricing_notes: Inceptron says EU-only residency uses the same pricing unless a contract specifies custom SLAs or regions.
prompt_training_notes: Inceptron says customer prompts and outputs are not stored by default and are not used to train its foundation or fine-tuned models unless the customer explicitly opts in or signs a separate agreement.

sources.notes: OpenAI-compatible base URL, bearer authentication, chat-completions endpoint, and documented MiniMax model identifier.
Current five-model serverless catalogue, modalities, context windows, quantization, throughput, capabilities, and token pricing.
Zero-retention default and no training on customer content by default.

verification.notes: Official API, catalogue, pricing, retention, and residency claims reconciled. Routing remains intentionally disabled.
